SELECT 
    mes,
    ROUND(CAST(canceled AS REAL) / total, 4) AS tasa_cancelacion
FROM (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', fecha) AS mes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN estado = 'cancelado' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled,
        COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM pedidos
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30'
    GROUP BY mes
)
ORDER BY mes;
